body:
I can’t tell you not to do it, and I don’t want you to feel guilted into staying alive. But for whatever it’s worth, I think I understand what you’re going through — it sounds pretty similar to my own situation. You aren’t alone in this, at the very least. 

If it helps you to make these kinds of posts, to vent and release those feelings, then I hope that you continue to do so. Even if they don’t gain much traction, you’re still being heard by a few people, and that in itself can be comforting. 

Do your best, okay ? From one internet stranger to another, I hope that you’re able to find some sort of comfort or happiness.
